title: Behavior2Trip: Towards Personalized Travel Planning via User Behavior Trajectory
abstract: arXiv:2608.26807v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Travel planning agents assist users in generating personalized travel plans by modeling their individual preferences. Existing agents either rely on explicit user instructions or engage in multi-turn clarification to elicit user preferences. However, both approaches overlook the rich behavioral signals latent in users' past behaviors, which implicitly encode their preferences. This over-reliance on active user input increases interaction burden and limits plan personalization. To bridge this gap, we introduce a new task, Behavior-Aware Travel Planning, which infers user preferences directly from past behaviors and generates personalized travel plans. To facilitate research on this task, we introduce Behavior2Trip, a benchmark constructed from one of the largest Chinese online travel platforms, comprising 11,400 instances. translated_title: 行为到行程：通过用户行为轨迹实现个性化旅行规划
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26807v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：旅行规划代理通过建模用户的个人偏好来协助用户生成个性化旅行计划。现有代理要么依赖明确的用户指令，要么通过多轮澄清来获取用户偏好。然而，这两种方法都忽略了用户过去行为中蕴含的丰富行为信号，这些信号隐式地编码了他们的偏好。这种对用户主动输入的过度依赖增加了交互负担，并限制了计划的个性化程度。为弥补这一差距，我们引入了一项新任务，即行为感知旅行规划，该任务直接从过去行为中推断用户偏好，并生成个性化旅行计划。为促进该任务的研究，我们构建了Behavior2Trip基准，该基准基于中国最大的在线旅行平台之一构建，包含11,400个实例。每个实例平均代表39.8条用户过去行为，涵盖5个偏好维度下的14个属性。
tldr: 本文提出行为感知旅行规划任务及Behavior2Trip基准，通过用户历史行为轨迹隐式推断偏好，生成个性化旅行计划，减少交互负担并提升个性化水平。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Behavior-Aware Travel Planning task and the Behavior2Trip benchmark, which infers user preferences from past behavior trajectories to generate personalized travel plans, reducing interaction burden and enhancing personalization.
